Read **Feel the Buzz — Sound and Vibration** with a partner or use read-aloud. Explore **Key Words**, then play Matching and Memory. Use **Keep the Ideas Clear** as a reference. Try **Sort and Explain**, **Explain Your Thinking**, and **Check Your Understanding**. Use **Remember the Ideas** to build a memory cue. Explain an answer using a detail from the lesson. Pictures support the activity text. A still picture cannot tell us exactly what a sound is like.

Picture panels: Feel and watch a shake; Different sounds; Join the investigation; Observe and record. Motion marks are drawing cues, not things you can see in the air.
